description: Compliance under Legal Metrology (PC) Rules and Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945.

requirements.title: Drug Generic / Brand Name
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 96, Drugs & Cosmetics Rules / LM Rule 6(1)(a)
requirements.description: Proper name of the drug or generic international non-proprietary name (INN).

requirements.title: Net Quantity (Units / Tablets / ml)
requirements.description: Number of units/tablets/capsules or liquid volume.
requirements.recommendation_template: State exact count of dosage units or volume.

requirements.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP - Incl. of all taxes)
requirements.legal_reference: DPCO (Drugs Price Control Order) / LM Rule 6(1)(e)
requirements.description: Retail price conforming to DPCO ceiling price guidelines.
requirements.recommendation_template: Ensure price does not exceed NPPA ceiling price and includes all taxes.

requirements.title: Date of Expiry (Exp Date)
requirements.description: Date of expiry after which drug is not recommended for use.
requirements.recommendation_template: Ensure Expiry Date is clearly printed and not obscured.

requirements.title: Manufacturing License & Address
requirements.description: Name and address of licensed pharmaceutical manufacturer.
requirements.recommendation_template: Provide registered manufacturing license number and facility address.
